title: Misconstrue
summary: MISCON'STRUE, verb transitive To interpret erroneously either words or things. It is important not to misconstrue the Scriptures. Do not, great sir, misconstrue his intent. A virtuous emperor was much

inlines.v: MISCON'STRUE, verb transitive To interpret erroneously either words or things. It is important not to misconstrue the Scriptures. Do not, great sir, misconstrue his intent. A virtuous emperor was much affected to find his actions misconstrued.
